prompt: A unified team competed in the 1992 Summer Olympic games. How many years old was the first leader of the largest member nation of that team at the time of the game?
answer: The largest member of the 1992 Unified Team was **Russia**. Its first president and leader, **Boris Yeltsin**, was born on February 1, 1931. During the Barcelona Olympics (July–August 1992), he was **61 years old**.
